title: Directory sign-in
subtitle: Students and staff sign in to Qadam with their university login and password, from Active Directory or another LDAP directory.

guide.title: How to connect
guide.subtitle: Five steps. The full guide for the university administrator is in the platform documentation.

steps.ask: Ask the IT department for the address of a domain controller, the certificate of its certification authority, a read-only service account and the organisational units (OU) of students and staff.
steps.preset: Choose the kind of directory: the filter and attributes get typical values.
steps.connection: Fill in the connection, the service account and the search base.
steps.test: Check the connection and one user.
steps.enable: Turn sign-in on and save: the sign-in page gets a tab of the university.

preset.title: Kind of directory
preset.subtitle: Changing the kind fills the search filter and the attributes with typical values.

texts.active_directory: Microsoft Active Directory: sAMAccountName login, nested groups.
texts.openldap: OpenLDAP with the memberOf overlay: uid login.
texts.freeipa: FreeIPA and Red Hat IdM: users in cn=users,cn=accounts.
texts.custom: Any LDAP server: the filter and attributes are set by hand.

preset.confirmText: You changed the filter or the attributes. The kind “{{name}}” replaces them with its own values.

connection.title: Connection
connection.subtitle: The address of a domain controller or LDAP server, and encryption.
connection.urlHint: For example, ldaps://dc01.kazutb.local:636. Several addresses separated by spaces are fallbacks, tried in order.
connection.startTlsHint: Encrypt an ldap:// connection (port 389) before signing in. Not needed for ldaps://.
connection.caHint: If the server certificate was issued by the university's own certification authority, paste the certificate of that authority in PEM format.
connection.timeoutHint: How many seconds to wait for the server (1 to 60).
connection.plainText: Passwords would cross the network in clear text. This is only for trying things out: in production Qadam refuses to save such settings. Use ldaps:// or StartTLS.

account.title: Service account
account.subtitle: A read-only account Qadam searches users and groups with.
account.passwordSet: A password is set: leave the field empty to keep it

search.title: User search
search.subtitle: Where to look for accounts and how to find them by login.
search.baseDnHint: For example, {{example}}. Nested organisational units are searched too.
search.filterHint: {username} is replaced with the login the person typed; special characters are escaped.
search.idAttrHint: Stays the same when an account is renamed: objectGUID, entryUUID or ipaUniqueID.
search.nestedGroupsHint: A member of a group inside another group gets the roles of both.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Which Qadam roles members of directory groups get.
roles.empty: No groups are mapped: everyone gets the default role.
roles.defaultRoleHint: For people in none of the listed groups.
roles.requiredGroupHint: When set, only its members can sign in.
roles.autoProvision: Create accounts on the first sign-in
roles.autoProvisionHint: Otherwise only people who already have an account in this university can sign in.
roles.syncRolesHint: The listed roles follow the directory groups; roles given by hand and not listed stay as they are.

page.title: Sign-in page
page.subtitle: How directory sign-in is named on the sign-in page. An empty field means the default text.
page.label: Name

check.title: Check and turn on
check.subtitle: Checks use the settings of the form, even unsaved ones.
check.stale: The connection settings changed after the check: check again.
check.enableHint: The sign-in page gets a tab “{{label}}”.
check.enableNeedsTest: To turn sign-in on, first check the connection with the current settings successfully.
check.changedNeedsTest: The connection changed: check it, or the changes will not be saved.

reasons.dns: The server name is not in DNS. Check the address or use an IP address.
reasons.refused: The server refused the connection. Check the port (636 for ldaps://, 389 for ldap://) and that the directory service runs.
reasons.timeout: The server did not answer in time. Check that the firewall lets Qadam reach the domain controller.
reasons.unreachable: The server's network cannot be reached. Check routing and the firewall.
reasons.tls_unknown_authority: Qadam does not trust the server certificate: paste the certificate of the university's certification authority.
reasons.tls_hostname: The certificate is for another name. Use the server name of the certificate in the address (for example, dc01.kazutb.local), not an IP address.
reasons.tls_expired: The server certificate has expired. Ask the IT department to renew it.
reasons.tls_expiring: The server certificate expires soon: remind the IT department to renew it.
reasons.tls_handshake: Encryption could not be set up. Check the port: ldaps:// usually 636, StartTLS 389.
reasons.start_tls_failed: The server did not accept StartTLS. Use ldaps:// and port 636.
reasons.plain: Unencrypted connection: passwords travel in clear text. Allowed for trying things out only.
reasons.plain_not_allowed: Unencrypted connections are not allowed: use ldaps:// or turn on StartTLS.
reasons.invalid_credentials: The DN or the password of the service account is wrong.
reasons.bind_password_missing: Enter the password of the service account.
reasons.no_such_object: The directory has no such entry. Check the DN, for example OU=Students,DC=kazutb,DC=local.
reasons.insufficient_access: The service account may not read. Ask the IT department for read access to users and groups.
reasons.no_entries: The filter found no users. Check the filter and the search base.
reasons.unwilling_to_perform: The server refused the operation. Check that the account is not disabled.
reasons.strong_auth_required: The server requires encryption: use ldaps:// or StartTLS.
reasons.referral: This entry lives on another server. Use a search base in the domain of this controller.
reasons.protocol: The server did not answer in LDAP. Check the address and the port.

userCheck.title: Check a user
userCheck.subtitle: We find the user without a password and show what happens when they sign in.

codes.not_found: No such user. Check the login, the search base and the filter.
codes.ambiguous: Several entries match the login: narrow the filter or the search base. This user cannot sign in.
codes.connection: Could not connect to the directory: see the steps of the check.

userCheck.name: Name
userCheck.subject: Identifier

outcomes.existing: The account is already linked to the directory.
outcomes.link: The existing account with this e-mail will be linked to the directory.
outcomes.create: A new account is created at the first sign-in.

reasons.required_group: The user is not in the required group.
reasons.email_missing: The user has no e-mail in the directory: fill it in or choose another e-mail attribute.
reasons.link_denied: The account with this e-mail belongs to another university and cannot be linked.
reasons.auto_provision_off: There is no account, and creating accounts at the first sign-in is off.
reasons.suspended: The member is blocked in Qadam.
reasons.email_unverified: The e-mail is not on the university's domains: a new account gets an unconfirmed address.
reasons.default_role: No group is mapped: the default role is given.
reasons.joins: The account becomes a member of the university.

save.staleText: Load them again: your changes were not saved.
